finalText:
Migration finished — all 10 non-vendor files (30 call sites) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The only remaining `db.query` is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which is explicitly marked "vendored, do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it alone. That means `db.query` in `lib/db.js` can't be deleted yet — it's still the vendor adapter's only path in. Worth flagging to whoever owns the legacy-orm upgrade if `query` is truly going away in the driver's next major.
